summary.headline: Judging Through the Ascendant
summary.text: Astrological instructions for judging a matter from the ascendant: determine the ascendant and Midheaven degrees, planetary positions and houses, then assess the lord of the ascendant and the Moon through aspects, conjunctions, falling planets, and the transmission or return of light.
